tasks.title: Typography, spacing, density and responsive grid
tasks.evidence: GREEN PASS. DP2-03 implemented in app/dp2-foundation.css and imported globally after DP2-02 tokens. The foundation defines a shared typography ladder, 4px spacing rhythm, density/control sizing, buyer-route content rails and responsive auto-fit grid primitives while leaving DP2-04 app-shell structure untouched. Required acceptance widths are explicitly encoded at 360/390/430 mobile and 1366/1440/1920 desktop. scripts/capture-visual-regression.mjs now captures five core routes at all six widths (30 screenshots per browser), and .github/workflows/verify-enchev-web.yml plus scripts/verify-design-process-2.mjs enforce the full width set. Initial run 35425535154 proved both Chrome and Edge captured 30/30 screenshots but failed only because the new CI assertion read the wrong manifest field; the assertion was corrected from entry.viewport.width to entry.width. A follow-up run 35425704149 exposed and then fixed a verifier syntax typo. Final exact-head run 35425750707 on fa3df259542948db58e1ecc0391d96b6cab25f5c completed SUCCESS: DP2 invariant/self-tests, mobile-first, accessibility, cross-browser contract, originality, aggregate CI suite, TypeScript, production build, built health smoke, Edge installation, expanded Chrome+Edge visual regression and artifact upload all passed. tasks.title: Unified responsive app shell and navigation
tasks.evidence: Implemented unified responsive ENCHEV buyer app shell in app/components/EnchevAppShell.tsx + app/dp2-app-shell.css and mounted it globally from app/layout.tsx. The shell consolidates brand, global vehicle search, primary navigation, account actions and purpose-built mobile drawer; legacy per-route headers are visually retired without deleting route code. Mobile drawer supports focus handoff, Escape close and body scroll lock. Core buyer routes retain main-content skip targets. scripts/capture-visual-regression.mjs now runtime-verifies DP2-04 shell behavior on every core route/acceptance viewport in addition to the 60-screenshot matrix. YELLOW pending fresh PR CI/build/Chrome+Edge interaction proof.
